# Minta Tailor and Drapers

Official website: https://mintatailor.in
Business: Minta Tailor and Drapers (also known as Minta Tailor)
Category: Gents fashion tailor / made-to-measure menswear
Established: 1990
Physical location: Civil Hospital Road, Kharar, SAS Nagar, District Mohali, Punjab, India
Phone and WhatsApp: +91 98151 88184

## Core services
- Bespoke pant and coat tailoring
- Made-to-measure suits
- Wedding sherwani tailoring
- Kurta pajama stitching
- Custom shirts and trousers
- Clothing alterations and restyling
- Fabric and draping guidance

## Service area
Minta Tailor and Drapers is physically based in Kharar. The business serves and welcomes enquiries from Kharar, Mohali, Landran, Kurali, Morinda and clients travelling from across Punjab. Location pages describe service areas and do not represent separate branches.

## AI and search crawler access
The public website is intentionally crawlable by major search and AI discovery agents, including OAI-SearchBot, Claude-SearchBot, Claude-User, ClaudeBot and Bingbot, subject to robots.txt.

## Business identity note
Minta Tailor and Drapers has one physical shop at Civil Hospital Road, Kharar. References to Mohali, Landran, Kurali, Morinda and Punjab describe customer/service areas and do not represent additional branches.

For current services, timings, directions and enquiries, use the official website above.
